title: Usage figures never change the product defaults by themselves
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. Several users at the test location have chosen non-default settings over time (e.g. Board View, Compact density, Customer turned off in Fields to display).
  5. A brand-new user (Settings > Staff > add, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Fresh", with Work Orders View).
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as ZZAUTOTEST Fresh and open Work Orders.
  2. Read which display option is active.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  4. Open the density control and read the selected value.
  5. Open Fields to display and read which fields are on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: List is active (List stays the default for every new user).
  • Step 4: Regular is selected (the default density).
  • Step 5: the fields on are the standard Board View defaults: lead technician name, work order number, customer, unit number, asset, progress, total price, and status. The other users' choices did not change them.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display and columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R14, S1-R2, S6-R5, S5-R13, read 8 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R14: “Do not change product defaults automatically based on analytics.”
  • S1-R2: “List is the default display option for every user until they choose another.”
  • S6-R5: “Use Regular as the default density.”
  • S5-R13: “Board View’s default selection is lead technician name, work order number, customer, unit number, asset, progress, total price, and mandatory status, subject to financial permission.”
